title: Count Smaller Elements With Opposite Parity
description:
You are given an integer array `nums` of length `n`.

The **score** of an index `i` is defined as the number of indices `j` such that:

	`i 
	`nums[j] 
	`nums[i]` and `nums[j]` have different parity (one is even and the other is odd).

Return an integer array `answer` of length `n`, where `answer[i]` is the score of index `i`.
hints: Analyze the constraints and data structures appropriate for Count Smaller Elements With Opposite Parity.
Formulate an optimal state transition or traversal invariant.
Consider corner testcases and boundary limits.
